summary: AI-native CRM linking prospecting, sales, customer health, and commercial agents in one record.
editor_note: The stronger idea is shared customer context rather than a chatbot bolted onto a CRM. Prospect, Close and Grow connect pipeline work with usage, billing and conversations, while agents maintain records and prepare follow-ups. A 14-day trial makes the workflow inspectable. The hard part is keeping autonomous upkeep trustworthy when billing, support and sales disagree about the same customer.
investors: Primary Venture Partners, Inception Fund, Defiant, Greens Ventures, Fabian Hedin, Ilkka Paananen, Peter Sarlin

product_evidence.claim: The product exposes Prospect, Close, Grow and Scale workflows, in-record calling, agent-assisted updates and a 14-day trial.
Grow joins product usage, billing and conversations to surface customer health and changes before renewal discussions.

market_context.primary_user: Sales and customer-success teams working across disconnected systems.
market_context.differentiation: A shared customer context connects prospecting, deals and retention with agent-assisted maintenance.
market_context.why_now: The Seed round supports inspectable commercial workflows with integrated agent actions.

risks.claim: Conflicting source data can make automated record changes and follow-ups unreliable.
risks.basis: Editorial assessment of joining usage, billing and conversations while delegating maintenance to agents.
